description: Commits the previewed batch: creates new client businesses, records owner approvals and queues package installations for every ready client; installations later configure each client voice agent. Requires an agency owner, admin or operator who created the session, its idempotency key, and the fingerprint and revision from preview. Clients that are not ready are reported with their next step instead of being installed.

approvalIds.description: The approval IDs returned by preview for existing clients.

expectedRevision.description: The session revision returned by preview.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for this request; reuse it when retrying the same request.

name: agency_enrollment_enroll
title: Enroll Clients in Offer
